links.outcome: AI performance on external multi-institution NCCT data for pathology detection (task 1) versus expert consensus
links.effect: Task 1 AUCs ranged from 0.49 to 0.59; task 2 AUCs 0.57 and 0.52; task 3 little-to-no agreement with ground truth.
links.quote: For task 1, areas under the ROC curve ranged from 0.49 to 0.59.

links.outcome: Model performance on independent external data versus expectations
links.effect: Models largely fell short; task 1 AUCs 0.49-0.59, task 2 AUCs 0.57 and 0.52, task 3 little-to-no agreement with ground truth.
links.quote: The first ASFNR Competition underscored the gap between expectation and reality; and the models largely fell short in their assessments.

screen.reason: Multicenter challenge/benchmark evaluating external validity and real-world generalizability of multiple AI algorithms on clinical CT scans, finding low performance.
